snippet.title: Kitchen Sync: Aloha! - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Kitchen Sync: Aloha!, a cozy story-driven cooking RPG developed by Lemonpepper Games. Players will embrace the role of head chef at the family restaurant to serve tasty Hawaiian food to the hungry clientele. Manage kitchens, explore the island of Hawaii, and find love in the bustling kitchen. Kitchen Sync: Aloha! is launching on April 7 for PC (Steam).

#KitchenSyncAloha #Gaming #IGN
